description: The tako server from frameworks/tako behind stock Caddy. Gateway: Caddy terminates TLS with h2 (and h3 for gateway-h3) on :8443, serves /static/* from disk with precompressed sidecars, and proxies the rest to tako's per-thread server on :8080 over HTTP/1.1 keepalive. Production stack: Caddy forward_auth against the shared authsvc on every /api/* call; the server does cache-aside in process (moka, 1 s item TTL, 30 s user TTL) over deadpool-postgres and invalidates on writes.
